  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ×××な彼女が田舎生活を満喫するヒミツの方法
  • 英語名: xxx na Kanojo ga Inaka Seikatsu o Mankitsu Suru Himitsu no Houhou

あらすじ

It’s basically about some country “otaku club” where fans of anime and manga gather. However, since it’s in the country the magazines arrive late and there’s not very many tv channels to watch. This means that they generally just help out around town and talk about anime occasionally. Due to this, they get called the “Cat’s hand club”.
